jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Norm

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.

Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role

We're hiring an Executive Assistant who brings exceptional organizational skills, sound judgment, and a proactive mindset to support up to four Partners at Norm Law. This is a high-impact role — you'll be the operational backbone that allows the Partners to work at their highest level, and your contributions will be felt across the team every day.

What You'll Do

  • Calendar Management

    • Manage and optimize complex calendars for one or more busy executives

    • Resolve scheduling conflicts and proactively prioritize commitments

  • Communication Support

    • Serve as a liaison between executives and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring timely follow-up on requests

    • Manage, prioritize, and triage incoming messages and correspondence

    • Draft and edit communications on behalf of executives as needed

    • Develop a strong understanding of Norm Ai’s business priorities and how they relate to day-to-day decisions

  • Meeting and Event Coordination

    • Organize and coordinate meetings, including preparing agendas and materials, and capturing and distributing meeting minutes as needed

    • Support planning and execution of events such as conferences and team offsites

  • Travel Arrangements

    • Arrange travel for executives, including flights, accommodations, dining, and transportation

    • Prepare and manage travel itineraries and any related documentation

  • Administrative Support

    • Support office operations such as ordering supplies, coordinating vendors, and keeping common areas well-stocked and organized

    • Perform ad-hoc administrative tasks as needed to support executive effectiveness

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 5+ years of experience as an EA or similar role supporting executives in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with a resourceful mindset

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and ability to quickly learn new tools

  • High attention to detail and accuracy

  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion

  • Proactive in identifying and improving inefficient processes

  • Comfortable navigating changing priorities and ambiguity

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in high growth start-ups

  • Experience planning and managing events

Compensation and Benefits

Base Salary: $110,000 to $145,000 per year

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Benefits: 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program

 

Work Location

Location: New York City

Work model: On-site

In-office expectation: 5 days per week

To learn more about Norm, visit our website.

Note: This position is for a full-time attorney role at Norm Law

What You'll Do

  • Document Drafting & Review: Leverage AI agents to generate, compare, and redline offering memoranda, purchase agreements, board materials, disclosure documents, and regulatory filings.

  • Due Diligence: Use AI tools to conduct rapid document reviews, identify key terms in documents, and generate client-facing memos of complex due diligence materials.

  • Deal Execution: Integrate AI agents into workflow management, signing and closing checklists, and coordination with counterparties.

  • Client Advisory: Partner with clients to demonstrate how AI-assisted workflows improve accuracy, transparency, and deal velocity.

  • Collaboration with Tech: Work closely with the technology teams to continue to make the deal process even more efficient using AI.

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD); active bar admission in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • 3-6 years of experience in Emerging Companies/Venture Capital transactions.

  • Strong drafting and communication skills; meticulous attention to detail.

  • Interest in applying technology to enhance traditional deal workflows.

  • No prior AI or technical experience required.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 Days: Learn firm AI platforms; begin supporting deal teams using AI-enabled review and drafting.

  • 60 Days: Independently manage discrete components of deals with AI support.

  • 90 Days: Lead AI-augmented workstreams in live transactions, improving efficiency and accuracy in document management and closing processes.

 

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary: $270,000 to $410,000 per year

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Benefits: 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program

This role is designed for an ambitious lawyer who wants broad practice-area coverage and who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment. You'll sit at the intersection of law and AI and see firsthand how the future of legal practice is being built, take on meaningful responsibility early, and grow into a trusted right hand to the Head of Legal.

Success in this role requires excellent judgment, exceptional organization, discretion with sensitive matters, and the range and curiosity to move fluidly across legal disciplines and between legal and business problems.

Core Objectives & Responsibilities

Corporate, Equity & Governance

  • Support the company's corporate and governance needs, including board and stockholder consents, resolutions, and other entity matters

  • Help administer equity and maintain the cap table, and keep corporate records and filings in order across the company and its subsidiaries

  • Develop a working understanding of the governance and relationship between Norm Ai and Norm Law and work with Norm Law operations to help administer it effectively

Commercial & Norm Law Go-To-Market

  • Draft and review commercial agreements (NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, vendor contracts) and build repeatable templates and playbooks

  • Review engagement letters and client proposals and support client intake for Norm Law

  • Help operationalize and systematize a go-to-market motion as an ongoing part of the role

Employment, IP & Data Security

  • Support day-to-day employment and HR matters and help maintain employment templates, policies, and handbooks as the team scales, with an eye to multi-state and multi-jurisdiction compliance

  • Manage IP ownership, assignment, and protection, and help safeguard the company's confidential information and trade secrets

  • Support data privacy and security compliance, including customer and vendor data terms, privacy policies, and evolving regulatory requirements

Strategic Collaboration & Enablement

  • Coordinate with outside counsel, prepare materials, and learn when matters should be escalated

  • Build the legal function's infrastructure — matter tracking, templates, and approval workflows

  • Partner cross-functionally with leadership, Operations,People/Talent, and the Norm Law team to support the business

Skills & Experience: Core

  • JD and barred in at least one state (NY preferred), with 2–3 years of experience at a top-tier law firm and / or in-house at a high-growth company

  • A generalist by inclination, meaning you want broad coverage across corporate, commercial, employment, IP, and data privacy / security rather than a single area of practice

  • Strong corporate / transactional foundation, with the range and curiosity to pick up adjacent areas quickly

  • Exceptional judgment, discretion, and ownership; you will need to be trusted with sensitive corporate, personnel, and client matters

  • Pragmatic and business-minded; you find the path to “yes” with appropriate guardrails and are comfortable supporting a commercial / GTM function, not just providing legal review

  • Highly organized and systems-oriented, with a low-ego, action-oriented mindset and no task too big or too small

Skills & Experience: Pluses

  • Exposure to startup equity, employment matters, IP, data privacy, or venture financings

  • Familiarity with law firm operations or professional-services go-to-market

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and what it means for the future of legal services

What Success Looks Like

30 Days

  • Complete onboarding and develop a deep understanding of Norm Ai and Norm Law, their structures, and the governance between them

  • Begin handling routine corporate, commercial, and employment matters with guidance

60 Days

  • Independently own recurring workstreams, routine legal administrative matters, standard commercial agreements, and provide support to various internal Norm Ai teams

  • Serve as a reliable reviewer of GTM engagement letters and proposals

  • Begin building templates and process improvements across the legal function

90 Days

  • Operate as a trusted generalist, owning matters end-to-end with appropriate escalation

  • Be a go-to resource for GTM legal support and internal legal questions

  • Drive systematization of the legal function's infrastructure and workflows

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary: $200,000 - $250,000

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Equity: Included

Benefits: 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program

Relocation: Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress-free.


Work Location

Location: NYC
Work model: Hybrid

In-office expectation: We are in our 1 WTC HQ 4–5 days per week

  • Build signature content programs: Develop repeatable editorial franchises and content series that establish authority, support campaigns, and create sustained engagement with target clients

  • Extend the impact: Turn major content pieces into channel-specific assets for social, email, events, campaigns, executive communications, and sales enablement

  • Own the metrics: Measure content performance, gather qualitative feedback, and use audience insights to continually improve topics, formats, distribution, and impact

Core Qualifications

  • 5–7+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, communications, journalism, or a related field

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a portfolio of clear, compelling work created for sophisticated or executive audiences

  • A track record of developing high-impact thought leadership and marketing materials across multiple formats and channels

  • Experience working directly with executives and subject-matter experts to develop original points of view and translate expertise into accessible content

  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to identify the ideas, arguments, and stories most likely to resonate with an audience

  • Experience independently shaping content strategy and leading complex projects from an ambiguous starting point through publication

  • Excellent project management skills, with experience managing multiple content initiatives, contributors, and deadlines simultaneously

  • Comfort engaging deeply with complex, technical, or highly regulated subject matter

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, moving fluidly from a broad idea to a polished final product

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for thoughtful action in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI, legal technology, regulation and policy, or another complex enterprise category

  • Experience writing for legal, compliance, risk, technology, or C-suite audiences

  • Experience creating research-driven reports, executive thought leadership, or original editorial franchises

  • Familiarity with content distribution, search, AEO, social media, email marketing, and audience development

  • Experience directing designers, video producers, agencies, freelancers, or other creative contributors

30 Days

  • Develop a strong understanding of Norm’s business, products, audiences, brand narrative, and existing content priorities

  • Build relationships with key executives and subject-matter experts across Marketing, GTM, Product, Legal, Policy, and Norm Law

  • Assess existing content, editorial processes, external partners, and opportunities to strengthen Norm’s point of view

60 Days

  • Present a prioritized content strategy aligned with Norm’s business priorities, target audiences, campaigns, and key thought leadership opportunities

  • Establish an editorial calendar and clear processes for developing ideas, interviewing experts, reviewing drafts, and producing content

  • Begin developing priority content with internal experts, including clear narratives, formats, distribution plans, and success measures

90 Days

  • Publish the first set of high-impact content and thought leadership developed in close partnership with Norm’s executives and subject-matter experts

  • Establish a clear roadmap for Norm’s ongoing content and editorial programs

  • Create a repeatable system for turning company expertise and market developments into timely, distinctive content

  • Demonstrate early impact through audience engagement, internal adoption, campaign performance, and qualitative feedback from clients and stakeholders

Range: $140K–$180K

What You'll Do:

  • Own analytics data products across internal business functions

  • Design and maintain reusable intermediate models, business-facing gold models, metrics, access controls, tests, documentation, and Lightdash agent guidance

  • Turn ideas into production data products by working with stakeholders to define requirements, validating the results, and publishing them

  • Reconcile concepts that differ across source systems, and publish mappings, unmatched records, assumptions, and quality checks so conflicts stay visible

  • Deliver changes through the full production process, including SQL, dbt tests, Lightdash metadata, access rules, content validation, and AI agent instructions

  • Diagnose incorrect or stale results across the data layers, and partner with data engineering when the cause sits below the serving layer

  • Review modeling changes, pair with teammates, and help maintain shared standards

What We're Looking For:

Core Qualifications

  • 5+ years of analytics engineering or equivalent experience, including contribution to a production dbt project with tests, CI, incremental models, and documentation

  • Strong dimensional modeling judgment: you can design conformed entities and facts at the correct grain, and make clear decisions when source systems use conflicting definitions

  • Experience delivering a metrics or semantic layer used by both people and tools, with safe access controls for sensitive data

  • Familiarity with and regular use of AI coding agents. You verify their output and know when they are not the right tool

  • Strong SQL skills and enough Python experience to understand existing pipelines and build transformation tasks

  • Clear technical writing. You treat model documentation and metric definitions as part of the data product

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Lightdash, or another semantic layer managed as code

  • AWS knowledge and familiarity with tools like Athena, Iceberg, and Spark

  • Experience with legal, private equity, or financial services data, including restricted or client-sensitive information

  • Experience setting standards or mentoring on a small team

It’s a key part of ensuring that our employees are operationally positioned to best deliver operational value to the company.

This is a white-glove role. You will work directly with partners and senior principals, often under deal pressure, and you will be the person they call by name. Support is your primary function, but the role sits at the intersection of service, training, and technology adoption, at a firm where the technology is the product.

You Will:

  • Deliver desk-side and remote support to Norm employees, across macOS and Windows environments, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams), Slack, iManage, conferencing, mobile devices, peripherals, and more.

  • Own the attorney technology onboarding program: device setup, coordinating account provisioning, and running new-hire sessions on iManage, Litera, Workbench, and other systems.

  • Run recurring office hours, floor walks, and enablement sessions in partnership with the Core Tech Team. You may also build quick-reference guides, FAQs, and short video walkthroughs so team members can help themselves.

  • Work tickets through our IT help queue, meet response and resolution SLAs, and document fixes so the next person can self-serve.

  • Process onboarding, offboarding, and access requests according to security procedures (approvals, least privilege, MFA), and escalate potential security issues promptly.

  • Manage hardware inventory and provisioning, and keep conference rooms, AV and other services in Norm offices ready for use.

  • Translate technical issues into plain language for users, and turn feedback into clear, actionable requests for other corporate partners and team members

  • Track and report support metrics (ticket volume, time to resolution, satisfaction, platform adoption) and propose improvements to the support model.

  • Help extend support coverage as Norm grows, including colleagues in other offices and time zones.

Skills & Experience - Core:

  • 3 to 5+ years of end-user or desk-side technology support, including at least 2 years in a law firm or legal/professional services environment (service desk, site support, or applications support).

  • A proven record of white-glove service with partners and senior principals. You stay calm under pressure, handle privileged and confidential information with discretion, and set expectations clearly and gracefully.

  • Hands-on experience with iManage Work (cloud preferred) and its Outlook and Word integrations; working knowledge of Litera Compare or a comparable document comparison tool.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across macOS and Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, and Google Workspace.

  • Experience with device management (Intune and a macOS MDM), SSO and MFA, and basic identity and access administration.

  • Experience designing and delivering end-user training, both in groups and 1:1, and writing clear, concise documentation.

  • Comfortable working in a ticketing system against SLAs; experience with Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent tools.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI tools and comfort using them in your own work. You can learn new, internally built applications quickly and teach them to others.

  • Security-minded: you understand confidentiality obligations and follow access and data-handling procedures without shortcuts.

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator who can explain technology to non-technical audiences without condescension.

Skills & Experience - Pluses:

  • Relevant certifications: iManage Work certification, Litera certification, Microsoft (e.g., Endpoint Administrator), or CompTIA A+.

  • Experience with legal workflow tools such as metadata scrubbing, PDF editing (Adobe Acrobat), closing sets, and data rooms.

  • Experience supporting a platform migration, such as macOS to Windows or a document management system cutover.

  • Experience as a legal technology trainer or with a legal AI adoption program.

  • Basic scripting or automation (PowerShell, Bash, or similar).

  • Background in a fast-paced startup or high-growth firm where you had to build processes as you went.

What Success Looks Like

30 Days:

  • Get fully onboarded to Norm's stack, including iManage, Workbench, our MDM tools, and the IT help queue in Linear.

  • Meet the partners and practice group leads you support, and learn how each group works and where the technology friction is.

  • Handle tickets independently and co-deliver at least one new-hire onboarding session.

60 Days:

  • Own technology onboarding end to end for at least one new-hire cohort.

  • Run a regular office hours cadence and publish or refresh the top attorney FAQs, starting with iManage and Workbench.

  • Consistently meet support SLAs, with partners in your practice groups knowing you by name and coming to you first.

Compensation and Benefits

Base Salary: $120,000 to $145,000 per year

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Equity: Included

Benefits: 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program

Relocation: Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress-free.

Location / Office Requirement

This role is based in our New York City office at One World Trade Center and requires on-site presence 4 to 5 days per week, since desk-side and in-person support is core to the job. On-call availability will be expected on a rotating basis.

To learn more about Norm, visit our website.

  • Build the communications strategy: Develop an integrated approach to media relations, executive communications, public affairs, thought leadership, and reputation management across Norm and Norm Law.

  • Advance the Norm Law narrative: Shape how Norm Law communicates its differentiated model, practice-area expertise, client value, and role in the future of legal services.

  • Translate narratives into executive and partner communications: Partner with the Head of Marketing to turn Norm’s core positioning—and the expertise of our founder, executives, and Norm Law partners—into social content, essays, op-eds, speeches, talking points, and public positions.

  • Lead media relations: Build relationships with business, technology, AI, legal, and policy reporters while managing inbound requests, proactive outreach, interviews, and follow-up.

  • Define messages and guardrails: Maintain core narratives, proof points, Q&A, spokesperson guidance, and sensitive-issues frameworks across the technology company and law firm.

  • Prepare spokespeople: Create briefing materials, lead preparation sessions, staff interviews, and ensure executives and partners communicate consistently and credibly.

  • Own the operating process: Establish clear intake, evaluation, approval, tracking, and escalation processes for media, speaking, podcast, byline, and partner-content opportunities.

  • Lead partners and manage risk: Direct external communications agencies, hold partners accountable, identify emerging issues early, and navigate client confidentiality, professional obligations, and reputational risk.

  • 8+ years experience leading PR, corporate communications, executive communications, public affairs, or media relations.

  • A track record of serving as a trusted communications adviser to founders, executives, senior partners, or other high-profile subject-matter experts.

  • Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, including experience ghostwriting executive or partner social content, speeches, essays, op-eds, and bylines.

  • Strong media instincts and experience building productive relationships with top-tier reporters and managing external agencies.

  • The judgment to navigate sensitive topics, client confidentiality, reputational risk, complex approvals, and highly scrutinized claims.

  • The ability to translate technical, legal, regulatory, or policy-heavy subjects into clear and compelling public narratives.

  • Strong operational ownership and the ability to build effective systems in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience supporting a law firm, legal-services organization, professional-services business, or other partner-led environment.

  • Familiarity with AI, legal technology, financial services, government, or regulation.

  • An established network across business, technology, AI, legal, policy, or government media.

  • Experience supporting major company milestones, law-firm launches, practice-area growth, fundraising announcements, or regulatory developments.

30 Days

  • Develop a strong understanding of Norm, Norm Law, their leadership teams, practice areas, audiences, existing narratives, and reputational priorities.

  • Build relationships with key executives and Norm Law partners while auditing current messaging, media materials, agency workflows, and communications requests.

  • Take ownership of the communications intake process and establish a reliable working cadence with leadership and agency partners.

60 Days

  • Establish aligned message houses for Norm and Norm Law, including spokesperson guidance, proof points, sensitive topics, and language governing how the two organizations are described together.

  • Launch an editorial program for our founder, executives, and priority Norm Law partners with a consistent calendar and review process.

  • Present a prioritized media and public-affairs strategy spanning company priorities, Norm Law practice areas, target reporters, opportunities, and risks.

90 Days

  • Run a proactive and reliable communications program with clear ownership, deadlines, approvals, and escalation paths.

  • Build an active pipeline of executive and partner thought leadership, media opportunities, and direct reporter relationships.

  • Ensure Norm executives, Norm Law partners, agencies, and internal teams communicate from consistent messages and approved positions.

  • Establish communications as a meaningful driver of Norm Law’s reputation, practice-area visibility, and broader business priorities.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Norm

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.

Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role:

We’re hiring Senior AI Security Engineers to build automated, AI-driven systems that find, prioritize, and fix security weaknesses faster than attackers can exploit them.

You’ll work across the full lifecycle, from discovery and threat modeling through remediation and response, and go deep in either offensive research or defensive operations based on your strengths. You’ll report to the Chief Security Officer and work closely with Engineering.

What You’ll Do:

Across the Role

  • Build defensive automation: Design, build, and improve AI-driven security tooling, with the testing, safeguards, and human oversight you’d expect of production systems.

  • Threat-model: Assess new and existing systems for risk, and use those models to decide where detection and remediation effort goes.

  • Respond to incidents: Join the response rotation for critical vulnerabilities and security events, from assessing exposure through remediation.

  • Measure and communicate: Track how well our security work is performing, and explain risks and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Research Focus

  • Find unknown weaknesses: Proactively hunt for previously unknown weaknesses using both automated and manual techniques, in a safe and controlled way.

  • Validate findings: Confirm and reproduce findings, and feed what you learn back into the automation to make it better.

Operations Focus

  • Run vulnerability management at scale: Triage, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities, automating as much of the process as you can.

  • Turn threat information into priorities: Bring threat intelligence and external advisories into decisions about what gets fixed first.

What We’re Looking For:

Core Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in application security and cloud security fundamentals

  • Strong software engineering skills, with production code in at least one modern language (ideally Python)

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI agents

  • Experience running threat models

  • Calm, structured judgment during incidents

Deep Expertise in at Least One Area

  • Research: Vulnerability research, offensive security or red teaming, exploit development, CVE credits, or bug bounty work

  • Operations: Vulnerability management at scale, detection and response, security automation, or software supply-chain security

Nice to Haves

  • Threat intelligence experience

  • Experience in highly regulated industries

  • Experience securing multi-tenant SaaS

Compensation and Benefits:

Base Salary: $155,000 to $215,000 per year

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Equity: Included

Benefits: 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program

Relocation: Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress-free.

Location / Office Requirement: Washington, DC (preferred), New York City

Work model: Hybrid

Travel expectation: Travel to NYC headquarters at least once per quarter

To learn more about Norm, visit our website.
